## Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened. Include any error messages or console output.

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain the problem.

## Environment
- **OS**: (e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14, Ubuntu 22.04)
- **mlrVp version**: (e.g. 0.6.9 — shown in the title bar)
- **Python version**: (e.g. 3.12 — `python --version`)
- **Audio interface / driver**: (e.g. ASIO4ALL, WASAPI, CoreAudio)
- **Grid controller**: (e.g. monome 128, Launchpad MK3, virtual grid only)

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here. If the app crashed, please paste the full traceback.
